term.name: context_variable
term.definition: The variable Q{XSLT}N an XSLT instruction puts in scope for a context function, read by a parameter default (SXML_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_VARIABLE) named N; in a template function, where none is in scope, the entry N of the tunnel parameters it received (its received context variables, scope entry Q{XSLT}context-variables, ); else the empty sequence ()
